description: No patch-automerge: PeerTube runs its database migrations unattended on startup, and its patch releases do carry them - of the 15 patch spans examined, v8.1.2 -> v8.1.3 added a migration re-encoding every actor's federation key and v8.1.7 -> v8.1.8 one invalidating all OAuth tokens. Version bumps stay human-reviewed pull requests here.

Some PeerTube versions also require manual migration scripts to be run after upgrading (see the IMPORTANT NOTES in PeerTube's CHANGELOG). Version bumps need to check for those and add them to `peertube_manual_migration_scripts` in `vars/main.yml`.

packageRules.description: Only consider the plain version tags (`v8.3.0`), ignoring the (upstream-deprecated) Debian-flavoured ones (`v8.3.0-trixie`) and the floating `production`/`develop` tags
